subject: Unable to reset my password
body: I clicked the reset link in the email but it just redirects me back to the login page without changing anything. I've tried this three times now from two different browsers. Can someone reset it manually on your end?

subject: Invoice shows an incorrect amount
body: This month's invoice charged us for 12 seats but we only have 8 active users on the team. Can you take a look and issue a corrected invoice or a credit for the difference?

subject: App crashes when uploading a photo
body: Every time I try to attach a screenshot larger than a few hundred KB, the page just goes blank and I have to refresh. This is happening consistently on Chrome for Mac.

subject: Export to CSV produces an empty file
body: I exported our ticket list from the dashboard and the CSV downloads fine but every row is blank except the header. This worked last week, so something must have changed.

subject: Cannot invite a teammate to my workspace
body: I'm trying to add a new agent to our organization but the invite button just spins forever and nothing happens. No error message, no email sent as far as I can tell.

subject: 2FA codes never arrive
body: I enabled two-factor authentication last week and now the SMS codes aren't arriving at all. I've double-checked my phone number is correct in my profile.

subject: Dashboard widgets are stuck loading
body: The ticket volume chart on my dashboard has been showing a spinner for two days straight. Everything else on the page loads normally, it's just that one widget.

subject: Billing address will not save
body: I updated our billing address after we moved offices, hit save, and it looks correct for a second before reverting back to the old address. Tried in two browsers with the same result.

subject: API returns 500 on bulk import
body: Our integration calls the bulk ticket import endpoint every night and it's been failing with a 500 error since Tuesday. Nothing changed on our side that we're aware of.

subject: Need to downgrade our plan
body: We're down to 3 active agents and don't need the Team plan anymore. Could someone walk me through downgrading without losing our ticket history?

subject: Search results look stale
body: When I search for a ticket by subject, the results don't seem to include anything created in the last few days. Older tickets show up fine.

subject: Webhook deliveries stopped overnight
body: Our Slack channel used to get a notification every time a ticket closed, and that stopped sometime last night with no changes on our webhook config. The endpoint is definitely still up.

subject: Feature request: dark mode for reports
body: Our team spends a lot of time in the reports section in the evening and the bright white background is rough on the eyes. Any chance a dark mode is on the roadmap?

subject: Duplicate charge on this month's invoice
body: I just noticed two separate charges for the same amount on our card this billing cycle. Can you confirm whether this was a processing error and refund the duplicate?

subject: SSO login loop
body: Since we set up SSO with our identity provider, logging in redirects back and forth between your login page and our IdP a few times before eventually failing. It worked fine in testing yesterday.

subject: Attachment previews are broken
body: PDF attachments used to show a thumbnail preview right in the ticket, but now they just show a broken image icon. Downloading the file directly still works fine.

subject: Timezone is wrong on all timestamps
body: Every ticket timestamp is showing three hours ahead of my actual timezone even though my profile is set correctly. This is making it hard to track our response times.

subject: Cannot delete an old project
body: I'm trying to archive a project we don't use anymore but the delete button is grayed out with no explanation of why. There are no open tickets linked to it that I can find.

subject: Rate limit hit during normal usage
body: We're getting 429 errors from the API during what feels like completely normal usage, well under any limits mentioned in the docs. This started happening this morning.

subject: Mobile app keeps logging me out
body: The iOS app signs me out every few hours even though I have 'stay logged in' checked. I have to re-enter my password multiple times a day now.

subject: Missing email notifications
body: I used to get an email every time a customer replied to one of my assigned tickets, and I haven't received one in almost a week even though replies are clearly coming in.

subject: Custom domain SSL certificate expired
body: Our support portal on our custom domain is showing a certificate expired warning to customers. I thought this renewed automatically — can someone reissue it?

subject: Team member permissions are not saving
body: I changed one of our agents from admin to standard access, clicked save, and when I go back to the page it still shows them as admin. Tried this several times.

subject: Import wizard hangs at 90%
body: Every time I try to import our old ticket data from a CSV, the progress bar gets to about 90% and just sits there indefinitely. The file is only a few hundred rows.

subject: Trial extension request
body: We're right in the middle of evaluating the product with our team and our trial ends in two days. Would it be possible to get another two weeks to finish testing?

subject: Report totals do not match the dashboard
body: The weekly report I exported shows 47 resolved tickets but the dashboard for the same date range says 52. Not sure which number is actually correct.

subject: Slack integration disconnected
body: Our Slack integration shows as connected in settings but notifications stopped coming through three days ago. Reconnecting it doesn't seem to fix anything.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I requested a password reset twice now and checked spam, and nothing has come through either time. Other emails from your system reach my inbox fine.

subject: Users table sort order changed unexpectedly
body: The admin users list used to be sorted alphabetically and now it seems to be in some random order. Nothing looks broken, it's just confusing to navigate.

subject: Need a data export for compliance
body: Our legal team needs a full export of customer data tied to our account for an upcoming audit. Is there a self-serve way to do this or do I need to request it here?
